prompt_set.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create the COMPLETE FINAL encoder pipeline illustration with imagegen, including the actual 3D objects, ALL lettering, arrows, spacing, and composition. This is a full illustration redesign, not a material atlas, texture sample, or recoloring of the supplied layout. Native high-resolution output requested: 4096 × 1536 or higher, wide 8:3 aspect.

REFERENCE ROLE: The supplied image is ONLY the architecture and numerical content reference. Its label placement is poor; do NOT preserve the label positions or huge monospaced text. Redesign the entire composition as an elegant, publication-quality scientific figure with carefully art-directed typography and richer 3D volume rendering.

LAYOUT:
Two spacious rows, each read left to right: top row Input → Stage 0 → Stage 1; bottom row Stage 2 → Stage 3 → Stage 4. Join Stage 1 to Stage 2 with a clean wraparound arrow in a dedicated empty gutter between the rows.
Use a consistent hierarchy: each Stage heading ABOVE its cube, the word Saved below the heading only for Stages 0, 1 and 2, and each tensor's dimensions BELOW its cube with a clear margin. Align the headings within each row, and align the dimension captions within each row. Never place a dimension against a cube edge or a label against another label.
Place each exact function call in a compact, readable monospace font centered in the open space above its own connecting arrow. Use neat two-line calls when helpful; the function-call typography must be smaller and lighter than the Stage headings. Avoid the oversized heavy code labels in the reference. Give the wraparound function call its own unobstructed label lane in the central gutter; no wires behind letters and no collision with a Stage heading.
Make a distinct, neatly spaced branch from Stage 3 to a smaller separate neutral tensor callout in the lower-right free space. Label that branch "To DiscoGraph". Put its own dimensions directly below the callout cube. Separate it from the Stage 3/4 headings, captions and operation label; do not crowd the fork. Reserve enough lower margin for this callout.
White background, generous margins, open flow layout, no bounding panels or flat operator boxes. Every label should have breathing room. Prioritize beautiful text alignment and a clear reading order.

EXACT CONTENT:
Top row:
Input — 256 × 256 × 13 — neutral.
Stage 0 / Saved — 256 × 256 × 32 — orange #FE9A27.
Stage 1 / Saved — 128 × 128 × 64 — teal #1DC59B.
Bottom row:
Stage 2 / Saved — 64 × 64 × 128 — purple #AD82C3.
Stage 3 — 32 × 32 × 256 — neutral.
Stage 4 — 16 × 16 × 512 — neutral.
Branch cube: 32 × 32 × 256, neutral, receives a branch of STAGE 3 before Stage 4.

Exact connecting labels, in sequence:
Input → Stage 0: encoder_stage(13, 32, r=1)
Stage 0 → Stage 1: encoder_stage(32, 64, with_3d=True)
Stage 1 → Stage 2 on the wraparound: encoder_stage(64, 128, with_3d=True)
Stage 2 → Stage 3: encoder_stage(128, 256)
Stage 3 → Stage 4: encoder_stage(256, 512)
Keep exact underscores, numbers, commas, parentheses and True capitalization. Do not introduce other operations.

3D FINISH:
Refined, tactile satin tensor volumes, subtle beveled edge highlights, gentle lighting and rich dimensional face shading. Maintain square, axis-aligned H/W FRONT faces for every tensor: front width equals front height. Channel depth is the slanted extrusion, separate from the square front. Do not stretch front faces into rectangles. Use the existing progression of face sizes and channel depths, with Stage 4 visibly smaller in H/W but deeper in channels. Keep all faces closed, opaque and crisply outlined. Stage 3 and its branch show the same shape.
Dark navy #071E47 text, restrained charcoal outlines, orange/teal/purple only for the three saved outputs. No duplicate teal tensor. Exactly six main-path cubes and one branch cube.
No title, logos, source credit, footer, H/W/C legend, extra annotation, decorative icons, glow or background texture. The slide supplies its own title and footer outside this image.
Deliver one genuinely polished, complete picture with the text expertly positioned as part of the illustration.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the complete imagegen encoder diagram. Keep its refined 3D style, satin materials, seven tensor cubes, all function calls, all numbers, navy text and white background. This is a typography/alignment and geometric refinement of the existing illustration, not a change of architecture.

Make these targeted corrections:
1. ALIGN THE LOWER ROW LABELS: Stage 2, Stage 3 and Stage 4 headings must sit on exactly the same horizontal baseline ABOVE their respective cubes. Retain Saved directly below Stage 2 only. Their main-path dimension captions (64 × 64 × 128, 32 × 32 × 256, 16 × 16 × 512) must also share a single horizontal baseline BELOW the cubes, with generous clear space. Keep the branch cube caption lower and separate from that main caption row. The top row is already well spaced; preserve its lettering.
2. SQUARE H/W FACES: every FRONT face is axis-aligned and must have equal width and height. Fix the visibly wide front faces on Stage 3, Stage 4 and the DiscoGraph callout. Stage 3 and the callout front faces should each be approximately 92 × 92 pixels in this composition; Stage 4 approximately 75 × 75, maintaining depth extrusion along the slanted channel axis. The other four front faces should also be square. Adjust cube geometry and nearby spacing rather than distorting the whole image. These are tensor volumes with H=W, and channel depth is a separate extrusion. Keep all dimensions unchanged.
3. CLEAR STAGE 3 FORK: align the two lower main-path arrows on one horizontal axis. The DiscoGraph branch must visibly FORK FROM the Stage 3-to-Stage 4 connecting arrow, with a small connection dot at the fork and a smooth downward/rightward branch arrow into the callout cube. Remove the current disconnected-looking parallel starting segment. Place To DiscoGraph above the branch's horizontal segment with comfortable margins. It must not touch the vertical bend or cube edges.
Keep the return arrow and its encoder_stage(64, 128, with_3d=True) label clearly in the gutter between rows, away from all headings.

The exact content remains:
Input 256 × 256 × 13.
Stage 0 Saved 256 × 256 × 32, orange.
Stage 1 Saved 128 × 128 × 64, teal.
Stage 2 Saved 64 × 64 × 128, purple.
Stage 3 32 × 32 × 256.
Stage 4 16 × 16 × 512.
To DiscoGraph: one neutral callout cube 32 × 32 × 256, from Stage 3.
Five exact operation labels:
encoder_stage(13, 32, r=1)
encoder_stage(32, 64, with_3d=True)
encoder_stage(64, 128, with_3d=True)
encoder_stage(128, 256)
encoder_stage(256, 512)
Preserve the first two top arrows and all numerical captions. No extra tensor, operation, text, logo, title, footer, legend or panels.
Keep the wide 8:3 canvas with generous outer margins. Render at the highest native resolution available, requested 4096 × 1536 or greater.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the complete encoder pipeline illustration. Fix ONLY the small DiscoGraph branch connection below the Stage 3-to-Stage 4 arrow.
The branch currently has two visible gaps and does not join its connection dot. Erase the broken lower starting segment and replace it with ONE UNBROKEN navy/charcoal branch:
start EXACTLY at the existing round fork dot on the main Stage 3 → Stage 4 arrow (approximately x=1138, y=543 in the 2048×768 reference); continue vertically downward from that dot to about y=623; curve smoothly right and run horizontally into the LEFT face of the separate DiscoGraph cube. End in one clear arrowhead immediately before that cube. No gap at the dot, no dashed segments, no floating or disconnected parts.
Keep "To DiscoGraph" above the horizontal branch, with margin from the vertical bend and cube. The branch carries the Stage 3 tensor 32 × 32 × 256.
Preserve absolutely everything else: all seven cubes, their square front faces and rich materials, all stage headings, all dimension captions, all five exact encoder_stage calls, the top arrows and wraparound connection. Keep all text unchanged, no extra annotations. Keep the white background, canvas size/aspect, and margins. This is a single connection repair, no redesign.
Render the complete repaired illustration at the highest native resolution available, preferably 4096×1536.
